CorePostCompileSteps.outputRule: New file under repository build/analysis; never overwrite input
CorePostCompileSteps.scope: Only the first scene literal; preserve lazy type initialization with RunClassConstructor
CorePostCompileSteps.preservation: All other bodies, definition tokens, MVID, attribute rows and blobs, assembly references and embedded resources

OptionalMachineFixture: A separately supplied machine file can be checked with -MachineFixturePath; no user machine is included.
